articles.title: Home Assistant explains automation traces to screen readers
articles.dek: Each step announces what it does and whether it ran, failed or repeated.
body: Home Assistant gives screen-reader users a spoken account of automation and script traces. Moving through the graph with the keyboard announces the step’s description and what happened during the run, where those stops previously had no accessible name.

Jan-Philipp Benecke includes errors, disabled steps, conditions that passed or failed and repeat counts. This extends the visual trace improvements reported on September 22 to people who cannot rely on the graph’s icons and colors.

pullRequests.title: Describe trace graph nodes for screen readers

articles.title: Fronius power limits can expire when Home Assistant goes offline
articles.dek: An optional setting returns control to the inverter after an hour without a renewed limit.
body: Fronius owners gain an option that prevents a Home Assistant AC power limit from remaining in force indefinitely after the system stops or loses contact. With the option enabled, the inverter drops the limit an hour after its last renewal and returns to its own control priorities.

Home Assistant renews an active limit every 15 minutes, leaving room for a normal restart or short outage. The setting starts off and is available during setup or reconfiguration. It applies only to the AC power limit; battery charging and discharging limits cannot use this fallback.

pullRequests.title: Let a Fronius power limit revert when Home Assistant stops

articles.title: ESPHome gives lights separate choices for restoring their settings
articles.dek: Makers can restore saved brightness and colour independently, while an ignored startup setting takes effect.
body: ESPHome lets makers choose which light settings return after a restart: keep a saved value or supply a replacement for each property. Brightness and colour can have separate choices, and the on-or-off state can also be inverted. The new restore_state setting replaces a fixed menu of combinations.

A light configured to start on, with no explicit restoration setting, also starts on as requested instead of being silently overridden to off. Existing configurations that explicitly set restore_mode keep their behavior. Clyde Stubbs also makes an initial colour selection choose a compatible colour mode instead of falling back to full-brightness white.

pullRequests.title: [light] Document restore_state:, deprecate restore_mode:, prefer ON/OFF

articles.title: ESPHome offers a single-install path to encrypted updates
articles.dek: A temporary plaintext exception reaches older devices, then needs removing to protect later uploads.
body: ESPHome adds an explicit, temporary exception for installing encrypted-update firmware on a device that cannot yet receive encrypted uploads. It gives makers a single-install migration path alongside the existing two-step approach.

The allow_plaintext_upload option belongs under the update encryption settings. Keep the old update password for the existing firmware’s prompt; the new firmware still requires encryption, and a rejected encryption key does not trigger a plaintext retry.

After the device accepts an encrypted upload, remove the exception and the old password. Leaving the exception enabled lets an attacker on the network hide the device’s encryption offer and downgrade a later upload to plaintext. J. Nick Koston adds an upload warning explaining that cleanup.

pullRequests.title: [ota] Add allow_plaintext_upload for devices that never migrated to encryption
[ota] Document allow_plaintext_upload for the migration install

articles.title: ESPHome connects kitchen automations to Hob2Hood commands
articles.dek: An infrared receiver can follow an AEG hob’s fan and light requests, while a transmitter can control a compatible hood.
body: ESPHome adds support for receiving the fan and light commands sent by an AEG induction hob and for sending commands to a compatible kitchen hood. Makers can use those infrared messages in their own device automations.
The feature uses an infrared receiver or transmitter configured in ESPHome. Contributor Mat931 supplies fan and light command handling and examples for turning received commands into sensor states.

articles.title: Home Assistant gives Austrian households advance weather warnings
articles.dek: New readings separate approaching warnings from active ones and add timing and type details.
body: Home Assistant’s GeoSphere Austria integration adds the number and highest severity of warnings that have yet to begin. Previously, it only summarized warnings already active, leaving automations without the advance-warning readings.

The active and advance severity sensors also carry the type, start and end of a selected warning. That selection gives more immediate weather events priority over sustained heat or cold, while the main severity reading still reports the highest actual level. Contributor a7rk makes a first contribution to Home Assistant Core with the addition.

pullRequests.title: Geosphere austria add advance warnings sensors

articles.title: Home Assistant changes NeoPool’s daily pump and light schedules
articles.dek: Start and stop times join actions for checking and correcting the controller’s clock.
body: NeoPool owners gain Home Assistant controls for the controller’s daily filtration, auxiliary-relay and pool-light schedules. Each supported timer exposes its start and stop times so an existing schedule can be read and changed.

The integration also reads the pool controller’s clock and reports its difference from Home Assistant. An administrator can set it to Home Assistant’s current time. Extra filtration timers and second auxiliary schedules start disabled; relay and light timers depend on the corresponding equipment being enabled.

pullRequests.title: Add service action foundation and device time to NeoPool

articles.title: Assist understands more Spanish shopping-list requests
articles.dek: Regional list names work for both adding groceries and marking them bought.
body: Spanish speakers gain more consistent Assist commands for adding groceries and checking them off. Both “lista de la compra” and “lista de compras” work for either task; previously, adding and completing items recognized different forms.
Juan Marcos Torero also expands formal and regional command forms and adds phrasing for marking an item as bought. Spoken replies stay grammatical when an item name is plural.

roadmapUpdates.title: RF reception gets an architecture proposal
roadmapUpdates.summary: Abílio Costa has opened an architecture proposal for receiving radio-frequency commands, a step toward tracking RF-controlled devices and triggering automations from their signals. The design remains a proposal, with no release date announced.
